pinning_note: Each model is restricted to named hosts with fallbacks to other hosts disabled, chosen 2026-11-06 from OpenRouter's endpoint list. gpt-oss-20b: DeepInfra bf16, then DekaLLM bf16 when DeepInfra is rate-limited (same full-precision weights; DeepInfra alone rejected 27% of calls with HTTP 429 in the rehearsal). gemini-3.5-flash-lite: Google AI Studio (first party; supports temperature). deepseek-v4.1-flash: DeepInfra fp8 (DeepSeek's own endpoint is excluded by the account's no-training privacy setting). The serving host of every call is stored in calls.provider.
